**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Governing law/venue (§14(a), p0064):** Delaware law with exclusive jurisdiction and venue in the state and federal courts of New York, New York. Delaware is an accepted fallback law and New York County courts are our preferred forum, so the clause meets the playbook on its material terms.
- **Noted, not flagged:** (i) substantive law is Delaware rather than New York — a minor sub-element short of preferred; (ii) §8 (p0028) also mandates AAA Commercial Arbitration, which sits awkwardly against the exclusive court venue. The arbitration is AAA-administered with no foreign seat, so it is not foreign arbitration or walk-away territory; the inconsistency is worth raising as a drafting clean-up rather than a GOVLAW deviation.
